artifact_role: Authoritative outcome handling audit; no product requirement, runtime change or release authorization

scope.supported_dispositions_basis: Seven governing decision records plus all 32 retained current assessments and six revision-addressed assessments. Four authority-backed disposition names are established; no external implementation enum was available.
scope.handling_status: Authority-derived process definition; automated enforcement and completeness against an external implementation remain unverified.
scope.authority_owner_meaning: Single accountable next-process owner; Agent-Ready remains readiness-verdict authority. Conditional escalation is a step in that path, not a competing owner.
scope.implementation_allowed_meaning: READY true is conditional eligibility only, never standalone implementation authorization; every non-READY and every execution failure is false.
scope.unknown_outcome_handling: Treat an unrecognized result as malformed_result and hold affected work for authority/schema resolution; do not invent another supported disposition.
scope.attention_status: Durable attention is required for judgment and unrecovered failure by the governing activation record; this audit neither asserts an implemented Agent-Ready event bridge nor activates anything.

invariants: Every supported disposition has exactly one defined authority path.
No non-READY outcome may be silently coerced into READY.
Resolved prerequisites never rewrite an old BLOCKED verdict; fresh reassessment is required.

dispositions.semantic_meaning: The assessed work is sufficiently bounded and authority-complete for execution without inventing product or architecture decisions; engineering research may remain. Readiness alone is not release authority.
dispositions.authority_owner: Wave 1 release coordinator (SWF-21, only while its bootstrap delegation remains effective)
dispositions.lifecycle_effect: Eligible for readiness admission; IMPLEMENT requires all nine SWF-21 conditions and all six release-record preconditions. This audit changes no lifecycle state.
dispositions.next_action: Check assessment freshness, Project READY, dependencies, authority, invocation absence, WIP, release ON, holds and durable release/baseline admission. Release only when every guard passes; otherwise preserve current state and record the failed guard. If SWF-21 has expired, use the canonical release authority; do not revive its manual delegation.
dispositions.required_artifact: Identifiable retained assessment with disposition, assessed contract/baseline, provider provenance and rationale; preserve prior assessment by immutable revision or dated artifact and link the new assessment to it.
dispositions.attention_behavior: Evaluate when a slot or dependency opens. Persist attention for a guard needing judgment; escalate genuinely missing authority, not routine waiting.
dispositions.stale_assessment_rule: Retain the old verdict as history. A changed contract, baseline, governing decision or material prerequisite requires a separate fresh assessment; resolving a blocker never changes the old verdict to READY.
dispositions.reassessment_trigger: Contract or baseline change, changed governing authority, or material readiness evidence invalidation.
dispositions.DAG_effect: No dependency edge is added, removed or satisfied by READY; dependency satisfaction remains a lifecycle fact.
dispositions.Founder_decision_required: Conditional: only genuinely missing Founder/product/architecture authority; routine authorized release requires no new Founder decision.

dispositions.authority_owner: Wave 1 release coordinator (SWF-21, within existing orchestration authority)

dispositions.semantic_meaning: A material owner decision or contradictory requirement prevents unambiguous execution; the implementer must not invent the answer.
dispositions.lifecycle_effect: No release into IMPLEMENT on this verdict; a clarification does not itself convert the assessment to READY.
dispositions.next_action: Present the exact unresolved question and conflicting evidence for a durable Founder decision. Apply only the authorized clarification to the contract, retain the prior assessment, and request a fresh assessment before release.

dispositions.lifecycle_effect: Hold the assessed work before IMPLEMENT; neither a split recommendation nor approval is a READY assessment.

execution_failures.semantic_meaning: Provider capacity, authentication, adapter or tool invocation failure prevents an admissible assessment.
execution_failures.authority_owner: Coordinator for attempt handling within existing delegation
execution_failures.next_action: Classify the concrete provider/tool error; preserve any prior verdict unchanged. Use bounded authorized recovery or obtain missing recovery authority. Preserve invocation identity, assessed input/baseline, provider, terminal/partial output and failure evidence separately from assessments. Do not advance readiness or lifecycle from this attempt. The coordinator may retry or fail over only within already-authorized provider/capability/budget policy; absent such authority, persist attention and a Founder decision request and hold affected work. A new invocation must yield an admissible fresh assessment; unresolved or repeated failure yields attention rather than an unbounded retry loop.

gaps.title: Absent in-repository assessment implementation, schema and CLI
gaps.finding: Accepted deterministic prework: no assessment-producing implementation, versioned assessment schema or Agent-Ready CLI exists in this repository. RAI finding dispositions are a different concept. No contrary implementation was found in the audit inputs; this is not a claim about external installations.
gaps.consequence: An exhaustive implementation enum, executable semantic validation and automated outcome handling cannot be certified here. This matrix defines authority-backed handling for the four evidenced dispositions, not an invented external schema.
gaps.fix_owner: OWNERSHIP GAP: the seven records do not designate the assessment implementation/schema/CLI maintainer. Founder assignment is required before an implementation fix can be tasked.
gaps.next_process: Record the gap for the Program Director to route to the Founder for owner assignment under existing authority. No Product Requirement or implementation task is created.

gaps.title: Unversioned serialization drift
gaps.finding: The 32 current retained files contain 15 direct readiness objects and 17 MCP envelopes. No top-level field is common to all 32; top-level disposition appears in 15. All 17 envelopes have isError=false and READY in structuredContent, matching the parsed text payload. Thus the normalized observed count is READY=31 and NEEDS_CLARIFICATION=1, not 17 missing semantic verdicts. No assessment schema_version is present.
gaps.consequence: A top-level-only reader loses 17 valid nested verdicts. Absent a versioned canonical serialization contract, consumers cannot mechanically establish full schema compatibility; the observed wrapper difference is not proof of conflicting readiness semantics.
gaps.fix_owner: OWNERSHIP GAP: no canonical serialization/schema owner is named in the reviewed authority. Founder assignment must precede a schema or consumer migration.
gaps.next_process: Present the observed two-shape inventory with G1 for owner assignment; preserve source envelopes and provenance. Do not rewrite retained evidence in this audit.

gaps.title: Inconsistent current-file retention of non-READY assessments
gaps.finding: Current PY-10.assessment.json carries READY without dated sibling files for BLOCKED or SPLIT_RECOMMENDED, whereas PY-09B retains a dated NEEDS_CLARIFICATION sibling. Both PY-10 non-READY assessments persist as retrievable Git blobs referenced by trajectory, with matching recorded hashes. PY-09B also has a second historical NEEDS_CLARIFICATION retained by revision.
gaps.consequence: Reading only current filenames obscures reassessment history and invites incorrect coercion claims. The evidence shows retention/discovery inconsistency, not demonstrated silent coercion or loss of the historical assessments.
gaps.fix_owner: Wave 1 coordinator for assessment evidence custody and explicit reassessment linkage under SWF-21, SWF-33 and SWF-34; a product-wide automated retention implementation owner remains covered by G1.
gaps.next_process: Preserve immutable revision references and explicit supersession/reassessment linkage in future authorized evidence handling; submit any broader retention standard to existing authority. No historical evidence is rewritten here.

coercion_finding.reason: SWF-33 explicitly refuses to treat BLOCKED or SPLIT_RECOMMENDED as READY. Locally retrieved assessments preserve BLOCKED at e25da1f, SPLIT_RECOMMENDED at 85b6060 and fresh READY at 93dd8b1 after PY-09B completed. The final assessment retains the earlier causes in assessment_history. Different current-file retention conventions do not demonstrate retroactive verdict conversion.
coercion_finding.limits: Local retained evidence only; no network, live-state verification or external Agent-Ready inspection. Trajectory timestamps describe commit retention time, not assessment execution time.

disputed.claim: Prework/prompt: earlier PY-10 verdicts survive only in trajectory/checker expectations; checker module commentary infers silent coercion is not hypothetical from the retention pattern.
disputed.finding: Both original non-READY assessment JSON blobs are retrievable locally at the trajectory revisions and their hashes match. Narrow the non-persistence claim to the current file set. No coercion is demonstrated; no failing checker assertion was altered or waived.

disputed.claim: The task describes LRN-008 as a provider timeout becoming a readiness verdict.
disputed.finding: LRN-008 instead records PY-09 verifier invocation success without a work verdict; it was refused as DURABLE_RESULT_MISSING and replaced independently. It supports separating invocation outcome from work verdict but does not demonstrate timeout-to-readiness coercion.
